web.account.deletion.toast.requested: Deletion request submitted — you can undo it within {days} days
web.account.deletion.title: Delete account
web.account.deletion.description: Once submitted, a {days}-day cooling-off period begins: your account keeps working and you can cancel anytime; deletion runs only after it ends and cannot be undone.
web.account.deletion.disposition.lost.it: Cart, favorites, shipping addresses, unused coupons
web.account.deletion.disposition.kept.it: The account itself (nickname becomes “Deleted user”, phone and password cleared); any shops you own stop trading
web.account.deletion.disposition.legal.i: Orders, refunds and after-sales records, payment transactions — transaction records carry a separate legal retention duty; deletion erases your identity, not the ledger
web.account.deletion.card.descriptionReq: Deletion requested — the account can't be restored once the cooling-off period ends.
web.account.deletion.card.descriptionIdl: Deletion is irreversible: you won't be able to sign in, and your data is handled as listed below.
web.account.deletion.card.effectiveWithT: Takes effect around {time}; you can withdraw anytime before then.
web.account.deletion.card.effectiveWitho: Takes effect when the cooling-off period ends; you can withdraw anytime before then.
web.account.deletion.card.pendingHint: Once submitted, a cooling-off period begins: your account keeps working and you can withdraw anytime; deletion runs only after it ends and cannot be undone.
web.account.deletion.cancel.confirmDescr: Your account returns to normal; you can request deletion again later.
web.account.coupons.emptyDescription: Browse around to see coupons from the shops.
web.account.orders.emptyDescription: Browse around and bring home something you love.
web.account.profile.note: The nickname is display-only, up to {max} characters. Avatar upload is coming soon.
